items.title: Add a verification_run command that resolves the intent, executes the pinned verifier, and atomically writes the receipt
items.context: New command in cli/command-catalog.ts + a handler; reuse B-ec67's enforceAndStampEvidence / runSingleAllowlistedCommand. lattice verification_run --storyId --intentRef resolves CHK-nnn:lane:index to its pinned verification:{command,selector}, executes it, and writes the receipt-bearing evidence in one step. Ideally verification_evidence_add stops accepting a caller-authored command for automated proof (accepts a generated receipt id instead), staged so callers are not hard-broken.

happy.desc: verification_run resolves a pinned intent, executes its verifier via the shared allowlisted runner, and writes a receipt (exit 0 + selector present)

edge.desc: verification_run on an intent with no pinned command/selector refuses with a clear error and never mints an unexecuted covered row

adversarial.desc: verification_run derives result from the receipt not the caller: exit!=0 or selector-absent is refused, a caller-claimed pass cannot override a real failure

items.title: Make the stale-evidence refresh re-execute the pinned command and re-issue a real receipt
items.context: Build on B-ec67's demote-on-refresh: when the material changed and the row is a mechanical receipt for an executable intent, re-run the pinned command via the shared executor and stamp a fresh receipt (bound to current material) instead of leaving it demoted. Coordinate with story B-3b88 (interim per-row laundering guard) which also edits the same function — keep the change additive. Do NOT re-introduce laundering: if re-execution fails or the command is unavailable, leave it demoted/non-mechanical.

happy.desc: after material drift, refresh re-runs the pinned command and re-issues a mechanical receipt bound to current material (not demoted) when it still passes

edge.desc: if the pinned command is unavailable or fails on re-run, the row is left demoted/non-mechanical — no laundering back to covered

adversarial.desc: re-execution routes through the same enforceAndStampEvidence refusal path (selector must match current output); a row B-3b88 per-row guard would demote is not re-laundered — both guards coexist

items.title: Add a fail-open PreToolUse evidence-pin guard hook on both hosts
items.context: Mirror the existing scope guard: .claude/hooks/lattice-scope-pretool.cjs (thin shim) + handlers/prewrite-guard.ts (read-only CLI verdict, e.g. prewrite_guard_check) + tasks/prewrite-guard-smoke.ts. On a verification_evidence_add/verification_run invocation the shim forwards the raw command string; the CLI verdict parses it and denies (exit 2) with a teaching message if --command/--selector does not match the pinned intent, before the write. Fail-open (handler is the floor). Claude matcher adds the shell/Bash tool; Codex .codex hooks add its real shell-tool matcher — gate the Codex side on an e2e test that uses Codex's actual emitted shell-tool name (the current Codex matcher is apply_patch|Edit|Write which does NOT match shell execution, so confirm the real token or the hook never fires).

happy.desc: the Claude Bash shim denies (exit 2) a verification_evidence_add/verification_run whose --command or --selector mismatches the pinned intent, and allows a matching one

edge.desc: any hook error (CLI missing, parse failure, timeout, no active story) fails OPEN (exit 0) so legitimate work is never blocked

adversarial.desc: with the hook bypassed entirely the handler still refuses the mismatch (hook is non-load-bearing), and the Codex hook fires on the real emitted shell-tool name (e2e using the actual token, not apply_patch)

verificationEvidence.note: Smoke C1/C2/C3 assert the guard verdict DENIES a mismatched --command (JSON blob) and --selector (--k=v) and ALLOWS a matching one; D1 the Claude Bash shim exits 2 on deny / 0 on match.

items.title: Add a RED-first smoke covering verification_run, refresh re-execution, and the guard verdict; register it in validate
items.context: RED-first per CLAUDE.md. Cover: verification_run executes the pinned command and writes a receipt; the stale-evidence refresh re-executes and re-issues a receipt bound to current material (not just demoted); the prewrite guard verdict denies a mismatched command/selector and allows a matching one; the Codex hook e2e uses the real shell-tool name. Register under packages/main/src/tasks + lattice.config.json validate.commands + package.json.

happy.desc: the registered smoke prints PASS and is wired in lattice.config.json validate.commands and package.json

edge.desc: the smoke is RED-first: each assertion mutation-kills — reverting any of the three behaviors makes the smoke fail

adversarial.desc: the smoke drives verification_run, refresh re-execution, and the guard verdict through their real CLI/handler entry points, not reimplemented logic
